title: Colour on the wall: mix the bitterness out
subtitle: Three layers of colour
intro: She doesn't want to paint. She wants to brush colour onto the wall and cover the person behind it.
closing: The colour covers the wall. The person behind it is still there.
doneLabel: Wait for the wall to dry

layers.label: Wall grey
layers.note: First paint the room the colour of no feeling.

layers.label: Hospital-gown blue
layers.note: Then paint the daytime so it all lasts the same length.

layers.label: Bug green
layers.note: Finally paint the things she hears.
